title: A machine-learning approach for predicting butyrate production by microbial consortia using metabolic network information
summary: The primary Methods use genome-scale metabolic reconstructions, pairwise interaction descriptors, simulated MICOM consortium output, and regressors; blind tests against measured consortia butyrate data report Pearson r=0.738 for two-member and 0.960 for three-member consortia, and lower Pearson but useful rank correlation for 13-member consortia. The claimed scope is prioritization/prediction, not experimentally demonstrated optimization.
